quarterly_data.quarter: Together AI press release: Together Post-Training: frontier-grade model shaping, the (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Together AI introduced Together Post-Training, a new service for building custom models on its platform from environment rewards via RL and supervision data via SFT (LoRA and select full-weight training on dedicated GPU allocations, custom losses), launching with open-weight models including Muse Spark Open, GLM 5.3, Kimi K3 and Qwen 3.8-27B, with the selection to expand in the coming weeks.
